messages:
maria: Opening a dedicated follow-up thread for the postmortem items from yesterday's outage (CloudNet routing + AuthCo token throttling). Posting owners and TL;DR action list here.
chris: thanks. can we centralize owners in one ticket so we don't lose cross-vendor steps?
amar: I'll own runbook changes + short-term routing fallback. target: 2026-04-05. planning to add per-region preferred endpoints + exponential backoff w/ cap.
liz: volunteer for model-registry token plan. thinking short-lived JWTs + refresh endpoint. target: 2026-03-31. security review needed.
kaela: security will do audit + threat model for token rotation and refresh flow. will also check logs retention for auth failures. ETA 2026-03-31.
tom: ops will add chaos test for provider network partitions to the monthly test matrix. I'll draft the test next week.
maria: action list (owners & due dates):
 - Amar: regional routing fallback and runbook updates 4c5 due 2026-04-05
 - Liz: model-registry token rotation + refresh endpoint 4c5 due 2026-03-31
 - Kaela: security audit + logging retention policy 4c5 due 2026-03-31
 - Chris: vendor SLA escalation & contact list (CloudNet/AuthCo contract review) 4c5 due 2026-04-12
 - Tom: monthly chaos test + playbook for simulated provider flaps 4c5 due 2026-04-07
chris: opened a parent incident ticket: INC-2026-0315-cross-vendor-mitigation, created sub-tasks CN-468 (cloud routing), AC-900 (auth throttling), INT-312 (runbook). linking shortly.
incident-bot: Reminder: 72h status update scheduled 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC
amar: quick fallback template I pushed to the runbook repo:
```
on model-fetch failure (5xx/timeout):
 - try region replica with X-Prefer-Region header (max 2 attempts)
 - switch to cached bundle (last-successful SHA) for up to 45s
 - if cache miss, fall back to lightweight model and attach event tag vendor-fallback
 - create ticket with vendor and infra metadata
```
liz: note: cached bundle must be signed and verified. I added checksum + signature check to docs.
kaela: addition: add alert rule for consecutive 401s > 10 in 5m with severity P2. Also log full auth provider response codes to quota logs.
maria: recurring pattern observed: auth provider rate limits during cloud network reconvergence -> our long-lived tokens + aggressive retries make it worse. proposal: quarterly dependency review + short-lived tokens + scheduled provider chaos tests.
chris: agree. will add "dependency review" as a recurring agenda item on infra retro and assign rotating lead.
tom: early test results: simulated auth spike + network loss reduced error tail after adding 200-800ms jitter and lowering retry attempts from 5->3. attaching synthetic run results to the ticket.
amar: commands used for network simulation:
```
# induce packet loss to emulate provider flap
kubectl -n infra exec -it loadgen -- tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 25% delay 120ms
# restore
kubectl -n infra exec -it loadgen -- tc qdisc del dev eth0 root
```
chris: vendor contacts updated in INC-2026-0315: CloudNet SRE (cloudnet-oncall@cloudnet.example), AuthCo Escalation (escalate@authco.example, +1-555-0199). also requested SLA clarification from both vendors.
maria: I'll draft the internal follow-up email after CN-468 & AC-900 are linked. please update task statuses using labels: todo / in-progress / blocked / done.
liz: added docs link in the ticket for token rotation: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/auth-token-rotation
kaela: small blocker: rotation plan requires schema support from model-registry. filing INT-312 dependency with product.
maria: noted. put "blocked" on Liz's task until INT-312 has an owner. we'll discuss at 72h check-in. :spiral_calendar:
